title: Asymptotics of a two-species particle system associated to the doubly parabolic Keller-Segel equation in the plane
summary: We consider the two-species particle system introduced by Stevens (2000) related to the doubly parabolic Keller-Segel equation. It consists of $N$ cells and of a varying number of chemoattractant particles. Cells diffuse in the plane and follow the (mollified) empirical gradient of concentration of chemoattractant. Chemoattractant particles are produced by cells at some constant rate, diffuse and disappear at some constant rate.
